title: rule-to-obligation-extraction
description: Structured output produced by the rule-to-obligation-extraction skill. One register per discrete piece of net-new regulatory rule text from a named regulator. Firm-agnostic and portable across firms; firm-side mapping is downstream in obligation-mapping. Downstream skills (obligation-mapping, policy-diff, implementation-plan) consume this record by obligation_id.

extraction_id.description: Stable ID for this extraction run, scoped to the rule under extraction. Reused by downstream consumers (obligation-mapping, policy-diff, implementation-plan).

scope_ref.description: Optional pointer to the scope record this extraction was produced under, when one exists.

as_of_date.description: Date this version of the register was produced.

source_citation.description: Source pin for the rule under extraction. The single binding anchor for every row in the register.

regulator.description: Issuing regulator. Examples: SEC, CFPB, OCC, FRB, FDIC, FinCEN, NCUA, NYDFS, FCA, PRA, ESMA, EBA, EIOPA, NAIC, state DOI, state banking department.

regulator_office.description: Specific office or division within the regulator (e.g., SEC Division of Corporation Finance; CFPB Office of Markets; OCC Office of the Comptroller).

citation.description: Full canonical citation. Federal Register cite (`88 FR 51896`); CFR codified section (`12 CFR 1002.107`); EU Official Journal cite (`Regulation (EU) 2022/2554, OJ L 333/1`); FCA handbook block (`SYSC 6.1.1R`); state code section; supervisory-letter docket (e.g., `SR 11-7`; `OCC Bulletin 2013-29`).

section_reference.description: Section, paragraph, or article reference inside the source. Use [verify section] when the precise reference is genuinely unknown.

publication_date.description: Date the rule or instrument was published.

effective_date.description: Date the rule becomes part of the CFR or operative; distinct from compliance dates.

compliance_dates.description: Compliance dates as the rule defines them. Tier-by-tier compliance dates each get a row.

tier_or_topic.description: Tier label or topic the date attaches to (e.g., Tier 1 covered FIs; Risk Management and Strategy disclosure).

transition_period.description: Transition framing as the rule provides it (e.g., 24-month phased implementation; deferred-effective-date provision; sunset clause).

url.description: Pointer to the published source (Federal Register, eCFR, EUR-Lex, FCA Handbook, regulator publication page).

extraction_summary.description: Headline stats that the regulatory-change committee reads first.

by_section.description: Distribution of obligations by section of the source.

by_action_type.description: Count by action-type enum. Optional; populated when useful for the committee read.

obligations.description: The atomic obligation list. One row per atomic obligation. Compressing multiple obligations into one row is the most common defect.

cross_references.description: Obligations that reference other obligations: recordkeeping rows tied to operative-act rows; reporting rows tied to determination rows; governance rows tied to substantive program rows.

defined_terms.description: Regulator-defined terms invoked by obligation rows. Defined terms change scope; capture each with its source pin.

definition.description: Verbatim or close paraphrase of the rule's text of definition.

source_section.description: Section pin where the term is defined inside the source.

transition_table.description: Effective-date and transition table. One row per stage. Implementation-plan reads this directly.

stage.description: Stage label: tier-1, tier-2, tier-3; effective-date; first-compliance-date; sunset; or rule-specific phrasing.

open_extraction_questions.description: Ambiguities flagged for legal review. Grouped by reviewer (legal, compliance, function head).

blocker_for.description: Downstream artifact this question blocks (e.g., obligation-mapping, policy-diff, implementation-plan).

handoff_targets.description: Next skills in the chain. Always includes obligation-mapping as the firm-side overlay.

review_gates.description: Named human-review gates this extraction must clear before downstream skills consume it.

confidence_label.description: Overall confidence label. Mixed is common; per-row confidence lives on each obligation.

human_review_required.description: Always true. The skill stops at draft; a named reviewer attests.

role.description: Reviewer role (legal, compliance, regulatory-change lead, external counsel).

source_trace.description: Citations supporting material claims about the rule's structure, effective dates, exceptions, and defined-term scope.

obligation_id.description: Stable identifier scoped to this extraction. Downstream skills key off it.

section.description: Codified section, article, or rule paragraph (e.g., `17 CFR 229.106(b)(1)`; `Article 17(1)(a)`; `SYSC 6.1.1R`; `SR 11-7 §IV.A`). Use [verify section] when genuinely unknown.

preamble_context.description: Optional preamble or recital pointer when the operative section reads differently in light of the preamble. Preamble is interpretive; the binding pin is the codified section.

action_verb.description: The operative verb the rule uses (shall, must, is required to, should, may). Preserved verbatim for traceability.

party_obligated.description: The actor the rule names. Use the regulator's term verbatim where the rule defines it. Examples: registrant; covered institution; board; senior management; CISO; BSA officer; third-party-risk function; ICT third-party service provider; data controller. Firm-specific role names belong in obligation-mapping, not here.

requirement_statement.description: One sentence stating what specifically the party obligated must do, on what condition, by when. Preserves the operative verb and the operative object.

condition_or_trigger.description: What event or threshold makes the obligation fire.

deadline.description: Timing the rule attaches: calendar deadline, event-relative deadline (`within 4 business days of the materiality determination`; `no later than 36 hours`). Absent a deadline in the rule, state the absence explicitly; do not infer.

exception.description: Carve-outs, safe harbors, transition relief, exemptions, with section pin.

action_type.description: Shape of the obligation. Drives evidence-shape expectations.

evidence_expected.description: Evidence shapes the rule expects. Named patterns only, not firm-specific systems. Examples: board minute; board-committee resolution; attestation; log; periodic report; policy artifact; training roster; model documentation; vendor file contents; regulatory filing; customer notice.

cross_refs.description: Other obligation IDs this row depends on or interacts with.

defined_terms_used.description: Defined terms the row invokes. Each term is captured with full definition in the top-level defined_terms array.

applicability.description: Who the rule names as in scope. Capture the rule's own framing; firm-specific applicability is downstream in obligation-mapping.

thresholds.description: Tier or threshold language as the rule expresses it (e.g., `2,500 or more covered originations in each of the two preceding calendar years`).

confidence.description: Per-row confidence. High where operative text is unambiguous; medium where interpretation is involved; low where reading between the lines or relying on preamble alone.

tags.description: Optional tags: sector overlay, cross-cutting overlay, COSO component, or firm-overlay-defined taxonomy.
